title: Find the display name of the user who has the highest total view count acro
question: Find the display name of the user who has the highest total view count across all their posts that were created in 2010 or 2011, contain the phrase 'data' (case-insensitive) in the title, and are owned by users located in either the United States or Canada. Only consider users who have accessed the site after January 1, 2012.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2010' OR STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2011')
  AND T2."XCL_035" LIKE '%data%'
  AND (T1."XCL_058" = 'United States' OR T1."XCL_058" = 'Canada')
  AND T1."XCL_056" > '2012-01-01'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_030") DESC
LIMIT 1
